display.title: Sefiras HaOmer at Home, Part 1: Shavuos, the Sefiros and Getting Ready for an Upsherin
display.summary_short: A father in Yiddish teaches his young son about Shavuos and Sefiras HaOmer, sings with him, and helps him practice what to say at his upcoming upsherin.
display.summary_long: A warm Yiddish home recording made during Sefiras HaOmer, as a father talks, sings and learns with his son, who is about to turn three. They begin with what the boy learned that day: the Beis HaMikdash and its korbanos, and buying letters in a Sefer Torah. The father tells a short tale of children who love learning Torah, then explains Shavuos: before giving the Torah, Hashem asked for guarantors, and only when the Jewish people offered their children was He satisfied. He teaches a new niggun about receiving the Torah with joy. Next he explains that the Jews counted the days from Mitzrayim to Har Sinai and sings the names of the ten sefiros. He tells how Avraham Avinu recognized Hashem at the age of three, and the boy rehearses a short declaration for his upsherin about following Hashem and starting to learn Torah in cheder. The recording ends with the Rebbe's niggun Tzama Lecha Nafshi and the song 'We Want Moshiach Now'.
display.lesson: The Torah was given because Jewish children promised to learn it; like Avraham Avinu at three, a child can recognize Hashem and begin learning Torah with joy.

date.note: Recorded during Sefiras HaOmer before Shavuos; the upsherin is said to be on Daled Tammuz 5741, the Hakhel year (6 July 1981).

privacy.note: Home recording of a father with his young son.
The child and his brothers are named throughout.

segments.title: Shavuos: our children are our guarantors
segments.summary: Hashem gives the Torah only after the Jewish people offer their children as guarantors.

segments.title: A new niggun about receiving the Torah
segments.summary: The father teaches and sings a niggun about receiving the Torah with joy.

segments.title: Counting the Omer and the ten sefiros
segments.summary: The Jews counted the days until Matan Torah; the father sings the names of the ten sefiros.

segments.title: Avraham Avinu at three
segments.summary: Looking ahead to the upsherin, the father tells how Avraham Avinu recognized the Creator at the age of three.

segments.title: Practicing the upsherin declaration
segments.summary: The boy rehearses a short speech about following Hashem and starting to learn Torah in cheder.

segments.title: The Rebbe's niggunim: Tzama Lecha Nafshi
segments.summary: They listen to and sing along with niggunim the Rebbe sang, then hear 'We Want Moshiach Now'.

segments.title: The upsherin declaration again
segments.summary: Father and son say the declaration together once more.

other_personal.text: The boy turns three and has his upsherin on Daled Tammuz 5741 (Hakhel year).
The boy bought letters in a Sefer Torah for one dollar each; he is about to start cheder.
